'''Vatok Tawr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]. During [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo's]] training under [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], Tawr would spar against her on several occasions, and eventually grew fond of her. While on the mission to [[Nickel One]] to kill the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]], he attacked [[Darth Caedus]] only to be impaled through his T-Visor by Caedus' [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] after attempting to disarm Caedus. He wore black and red [[Armor/Legends|armor]].
